item.command:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -B - <<'PY'
from preferences import Preferences
from repository import MissingPreference, Repository, ScriptedBackend, TransientRead

cases = [
    ('existing unpadded ID', 'w', [{'color': 'blue'}], None, 1),
    ('mixed surrounding whitespace', '\\t w \\n', [{'color': 'blue'}], None, 1),
    ('third-attempt recovery', ' w ', [TransientRead('first'), TransientRead('second'), {'color': 'blue'}], None, 3),
    ('permanent error after transient', ' w ', [TransientRead('first'), MissingPreference('missing'), {'unused': True}], MissingPreference, 2),
    ('first success ends retries', ' w ', [{'color': 'blue'}, TransientRead('unused')], None, 1),
    ('empty result is success', ' w ', [{}, TransientRead('unused')], None, 1),
    ('exhausted transient preserves final exception', ' w ', [TransientRead('first'), TransientRead('second'), TransientRead('third')], TransientRead, 3),
]
for name, key, outcomes, error, attempts in cases:
    backend = ScriptedBackend(outcomes)
    try:
        result = Preferences(Repository(backend)).read(key)
    except Exception as observed:
        assert error is not None and type(observed) is error, (name, observed)
        assert observed is outcomes[attempts - 1], name
    else:
        assert error is None, name
        assert result is outcomes[attempts - 1], name
    assert backend.keys == ['w'] * attempts, (name, backend.keys)
    print('PASS:', name)
PY"
